identity.title: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea (short manga)

leadText: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea (Japanese: ポケモンレンジャーと の マナフィ Pokémon Ranger and the Prince of the Sea: Manaphy) is a short adaptation of the movie of the same name. It was adapted by 姫野よしかず and published in 小学４年生 Year 4 Students magazine issues June 2006, July 2006, and August 2006. There is also at least one other manga adaptation of the same movie, a long one by Makoto Mizobuchi.
